nodes.description: msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, payouts and authorisation
block.timestamp (now): miner-influenced time used for cooldowns, eruptions and randomness
tx.origin: used in require(tx.origin == msg.sender) authorisation checks
Ownable.owner: contract owner receiving fees, tokens and able to kill the contract
uint32[] ids: array of character ids used for iteration, picking and removal
uint32 nextId: id handed to the next character
uint32 oldest: id of the oldest dragon (dragon king)
mapping(uint32 => Character) characters: type, value, owner, purchase time
mapping(uint32 => bool) teleported: knights already on the battlefield
uint128[] costs: purchase price per character type
uint128[] values: stored value (cost minus fee) per character type
uint8 fee: fee percentage charged on purchases
uint16 numCharacters: total characters currently in the game
uint16 maxCharacters: cap on characters in the game
mapping(uint8 => uint16) numCharactersXType: count per character type
uint eruptionThreshold: seconds required between eruptions
uint256 lastEruptionTimestamp: time of the last eruption
uint8 percentageToKill: share of characters hit by an eruption
mapping(uint32 => uint) cooldown: earliest time a knight may fight again
uint8 fightFactor: scales the power advantage in a fight
Token teleportToken: TPT contract used to teleport knights
uint teleportPrice: token price for teleporting a knight
Token neverdieToken: NDC contract used to buy protection
uint protectionPrice: token price per protection life
mapping(uint32 => uint8) protection: remaining lives of a character
Token sklToken: SKL contract used for fight power
Token xperToken: XP contract used for fight power
uint8 constant numDragonTypes = 6, type index boundary between dragons and knights
function DragonKing(...) onlyOwner: initialises prices, tokens and thresholds
function addCharacters(uint8 characterType) payable: buys characters
function addCharacter(uint32 nId, uint16 nchars) internal: pushes id into ids
function exit(): removes caller characters, pays out balance
function replaceCharacter(uint16 index, uint16 nchars) internal: swap-and-pop ids
function triggerVolcanoEruption(): kills a percentage of characters and distributes pot
function fight(uint32 knightID, uint16 knightIndex): knight attacks a dragon
function getRandomDragon(uint256 nonce) internal view: picks a dragon index
function generateRandomNumber(uint256 nonce) internal view: keccak of blockhash, now, nonce
function hitCharacter(uint16 index, uint16 nchars) internal: kills/replaces a character
function findOldest() public: recomputes the oldest dragon id
function distribute(uint128 totalAmount) internal: shares pot among survivors
function withdraw() public onlyOwner: withdraws NDC and TPT tokens
function payOut() public onlyOwner: pays out and deletes all characters
function stop() public onlyOwner: withdraw, payOut, kill
function sellCharacter(uint32 characterId): sells a character back
function receiveApproval(address sender, uint256 value, address tokenContract, bytes callData)
function teleportKnight(uint32 id) internal: brings a knight into play
function protectCharacter(uint32 id, uint8 lifes) internal
function getFees() constant public: balance minus reserved values
function toUint32(bytes b) internal pure: decodes an id from callData
neverdieToken.transfer and teleportToken.transfer to owner in withdraw()
unchecked uint128/uint256 arithmetic: pot += value, shares = amount * values[m] / valueSum / numCharactersXType[m], nextId = nid + amount, balance - reserved
external sklToken.balanceOf / xperToken.balanceOf calls in fight()
keccak256(block.blockhash(block.number - 1), now, numCharacters, nonce) is predictable
local value returned by hitCharacter in triggerVolcanoEruption
